items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What about Bachman? Is there much of that? INTERVIEWEE: Quite a bit.

ctx.x: I sat on the ground and sometimes the bands not playing, like with Kidman, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly. I sat on the ground and even the truck was riding with these guys.
What about Bachman? Is there much of that?

Quite a bit. We stopped on the corner and we didn't play until one thought, well, you had enough of your driving and you had enough publicity. Let's go home first. We left the first corner so I had to go for a certain thing. Are the same bands? Sure. Ah, we're about to put up these. Yeah, sure it was. A lot of guys don't tell you that. It's the first time I ever heard it. That's right. We circled here. The cops were stopped and got the cornered by an hour or so later to beat up somewhere else. So they brought in…
